CHAR_RABBIT.description: Small stuffed rabbit, fat and bunchy; spotted brown-and-white velveteen; thread whiskers; ears lined pink sateen; boot-button eyes; later threadbare, unsewn tail, pink rubbed from nose, shape lost; final living form brown soft fur with faint spotted markings under coat.
CHAR_RABBIT.display_name_policy: On-screen and credits: the Velveteen Rabbit / Bunny; never invent a personal name.

voice_profile.register: gentle childlike toy voice for sparse sourced lines
voice_profile.dialect: neutral storybook English matching source diction

visual_lock.palette: brown-white spots, pink sateen ears fading to grey
visual_lock.materials: velveteen to threadbare cloth to living fur
visual_lock.faces: boot-button eyes gaining wise look; living round black eyes at end

CHAR_RABBIT.source_evidence: HERE was once a velveteen rabbit, and in the beginning he was really splendid. He was fat and bunchy, as a rabbit should be; his coat was spotted brown and white, he had real thread whiskers, and his ears were lined with pink sateen.

CHAR_BOY.description: A kind-hearted little boy who loves the Rabbit, makes bed-tunnels and garden burrows, falls ill with scarlet fever, recovers, goes to seaside plans, later plays in the spring wood.
CHAR_BOY.display_name_policy: Always the Boy; no invented personal name.
